title: Display skin (one JSON file per console display look)
description: Lays out one console display as data, so its look can change without code. Skins shipped in the repository are generic look-alikes: the same fields, positions, colours and scales as a real unit, with no maker names, model names or logos. Rectangles are [x, y, width, height] in reference pixels with the origin at the top left.

id.description: Unique among skins for the same display, for example generic-a

reference.description: [width, height] the rectangles are written against

viewport.description: radar and plotter only: where the live picture goes

pages.description: Page names; the first is shown at start. Absent means a single page.

type.description: list (appended): every alarm the readout defines, grouped by alarm group, each with a lamp and its state in words

page.description: The page this element belongs to; absent means every page

channel.description: Instrument channel name. {side} is replaced by port or starboard for a per-engine display.

alarm.description: Alarm id for a lamp; {side} is replaced as for channel

range.description: [low, high] in the display unit: the ends of a dial or bar

sweep.description: dial only: needle angle in degrees at the low and high ends, clockwise from straight up

unit.description: Display unit; the channel's SI value is converted to it

decimals.description: Digits after the decimal point for a value

text.description: Fixed caption for text, softkey and the label of a dial, bar or value

target.description: softkey only: the page it opens

colour.description: A palette role name, or #RRGGBB for the day palette with the night palette derived from it

format.description: value only (appended): number (the default) or gear, which shows a shift-phase channel as NEUTRAL, AHEAD, ASTERN or SHIFTING

group.description: list only (appended): show only the alarms of this group; absent means every group

action.description: softkey only (appended): the alarm action the key raises; lamp-test is held while pressed. A softkey has a target or an action, not both.

bands.description: dial and bar only (appended): coloured ranges such as warning and red-line arcs, drawn once with the static face

range.description: [low, high] in the element's display unit, inside the element's range, low below high

colour.description: A palette role name or #RRGGBB, as for an element
